parameter.name: enabled
parameter.label: Enable Inbox Rules
parameter.description: Enable or disable all inbox auto-approval rules and customizations.

parameter.name: rules
parameter.label: Auto-approve rules
parameter.description:
Rules are evaluated sequentially until a match is found. Prefix with # or // to disable a rule.
Syntax: criteriaKey=value; actionKey=value (supports * and ? wildcards)
Filters: thingUid, bridgeUid, label, representationProperty, propertyMatch, configMatch
Actions: setLabel, setLocation, setProperties, setConfig (optional post-approval customizations)
Advanced: Actions support interpolation (${label}, ${thingUID}, ${bridgeUID}, ${properties.name}) and comma-separated values (e.g., setProperties=room=Kitchen,source=${properties.id}).
Example: thingUid=hue:*; label=*Motion*; setLocation=Living Room; setLabel=${label} Sensor
